title: lean-spectral-theory
summary: The spectral theorem for possibly unbounded self-adjoint operators on complex Hilbert spaces, formalized through the Cayley transform and real projection-valued measures. The selected spectral theorem constructs a PVM whose scalar measures give the exact finite-second-moment domain and first-moment quadratic form, with measurable-set uniqueness, and is proved equivalent to equality with the unbounded coordinate spectral integral.
